name: ai-visit-website
description: Discover public websites, read clean Markdown, save reviewed pages without duplicates, and search a local archive.

interface.shortDescription: Visit, archive, and search public websites
interface.longDescription: Discover public-site structure, convert selected pages to clean Markdown, explicitly archive reviewed content with SHA-256 deduplication, and search saved evidence locally.
defaultPrompt: Discover this public website and identify the pages relevant to my goal.
Read this page as clean Markdown and show me the source metadata.
Search my saved website archive for evidence about this topic.
